sn12.23:1.2: Jānato ham bhikkhave passato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi no ajānato no appassato || || 3 Kiṃ
sn12.23:1.3: ca bhikkhave jānato kiṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || ||
sn12.23:1.4: Iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo ||
sn12.23:1.8: Iti viññāṇaṃ || iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo ti || ||
sn12.23:1.9: Evam kho bhikkhave jānato evam passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || 4

sn12.23:7.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave uparipabbate phullaphusitake deve vassante tam udakaṃ yathā ninnam pavattamānam pabbata-kandara-padara-sākhā paripūreti || pabbata-kandara-padara-sākhā paripūrā kusubbhe paripūrenti || kusubbhā paripūrā mahāsobbhe paripūrenti || mahāsobbhā paripūrā kunnadiyo paripūrenti || kunnadiyo paripūrā mahānadiyo paripūrenti || mahānadiyo paripūrā mahāsamuddam sāgaram paripūrenti || 28
sn12.23:8.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave avijjūpanisā saṅkhārā || Saṅkhārūpanisaṃ viññāṇam || viññāṇūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ || nāmarūpūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ || saḷāyātanūpaniso phasso || phassūpanisā vedanā || vedanūpanisā taṇhā || taṇhūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ || upādānūpaniso bhavo || bhavūpanisā jāti || jātūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ || dukkhūpanisā saddhā || saddhūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ || pāmojjūpanisā pīti || pītūpanisā passaddhi || passaddhūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ || sukhūpaniso samādhi || samādhūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ || yathābhūtañāṇadassanūpanisā nibbidā || nibbidūpaniso virāgo || virāgūpanisā vimutti || vimuttūpanisaṃ khaye ñāṇanti || ||
